s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent gross hematuria in a patient with a history of pelvic surgery and radiation
salient_findings: Pulsatile arterial bleeding from the right ureteral orifice
Active hemorrhage at the right renal pelvis with clots in the collecting system
key_facts: Treated with liver metastasectomy, Hartmann’s procedure, and intraoperative radiotherapy
History of bilateral JJ stents for ureteral strictures
Cystoscopy and ureteral stent exchange performed
Embolisation of the right renal artery with coils performed

Fistula between ureter and iliac vessels

Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor of the ureter

shortlist.label: Radiation cystitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of pelvic radiation and recurrent gross hematuria

shortlist.label: Ureteroenteric fistula
shortlist.why_kept: Ureteroileal fistula found during left stent repositioning

shortlist.label: Arteriovenous fistula
shortlist.why_kept: Pulsatile arterial bleeding from the right ureteral orifice

shortlist.label: Pseudoaneurysm
shortlist.why_kept: Active hemorrhage at the right renal pelvis with clots in the collecting system

shortlist.label: Ureteral stricture
shortlist.why_kept: History of bilateral JJ stents for ureteral strictures and recurrent hematuria

raw.rationale: The patient's history of intraoperative radiotherapy and subsequent development of hematuria, ureteral strictures, and hydronephrosis are consistent with radiation-induced damage to the urinary tract, which is a common cause of radiation cystitis.

rejected.label: Ureteroenteric fistula
rejected.why: Although a ureteroileal fistula was found, it does not fully explain the patient's initial presentation of gross hematuria and bilateral hydronephrosis.

rejected.label: Arteriovenous fistula
rejected.why: There is no direct evidence of an arteriovenous fistula, and the patient's symptoms are more consistent with radiation-induced damage.

rejected.label: Pseudoaneurysm
rejected.why: The embolisation of the right renal artery with coils was performed to control bleeding, but there is no indication of a pseudoaneurysm.

rejected.label: Ureteral stricture
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of ureteral strictures, it does not fully explain the patient's gross hematuria and bilateral hydronephrosis.
